basic_info.description: 1096 Fulton Street presents a rare opportunity to acquire a multifamily property directly across from San Francisco's iconic Alamo Square Park. Situated on a corner lot next to the park's north staircase, this 12-unit building features six one-bedroom and six studio apartments above eleven individual garages. Many of its original ornate details have been preserved, complemented by modern upgrades and enhanced functionality.     Alamo Square is a picturesque neighborhood in San Francisco, best known for its iconic Painted Ladies, colorful Victorian homes set against the backdrop of the city skyline. The park offers stunning views, lush green spaces, and a relaxed atmosphere popular with locals and visitors alike. Just a short walk away, the Divisadero retail district is a vibrant corridor lined with trendy cafes, boutique shops, and popular restaurants, making it a hotspot for dining, nightlife, and unique local businesses.    This is an exceptional opportunity to invest in a well-located multifamily property with significant financial upside in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
